mobile.rules.blockReport: Use Block and Report on any bad partner — you can leave anytime.
mobile.safety.deleteBody: Identity lives on this device (export backup in Settings). Hub data (friends, reports) can be deleted via the web form or by emailing privacy@ruletka.me.
mobile.safety.intro: Quick tips for every call. Full guide on the web.
mobile.safety.tip1: You’re 18+ — leave if a partner looks underage or asks for money.
mobile.safety.tip2: Block and Report are always available during a live call.
mobile.safety.tip3: Partners may screenshot or record — don’t share secrets or nudes you regret.
mobile.safety.tip4: Hide IP (Settings) uses TURN relay when the hub provides it.
